title: Ukraine Gains Ground as Putin Faces Pressure
title_cn: 普京面临压力，乌克兰取得进展
summary:
Russia is weighing support for retailers after Ukrainian strikes caused billions of dollars of estimated losses at warehouses owned by Wildberries, the country’s answer to Amazon. 
Ukrainian drones began targeting warehouses operated by Wildberries in mid-July, with more than a dozen facilities from southern Russia to the Urals affected. 
The attacks have killed several people and injured dozens more, while Wildberries has lost at least 17% of its warehouse capacity. 
Sergei Guriev, Dean of the London Business School, discusses the latest developments in the Ukraine, Russia war. (Source: Bloomberg)
